sections.content: Use pero, *sin* *embargo*, *aunque*, a *pesar* de and en cambio to contrast ideas and concede a point.

items.english: Although it was difficult, we continued.

items.spanish: Era caro; sin embargo, decidimos comprarlo.
items.english: It was expensive; however, we decided to buy it.

items.spanish: A pesar de ser caro, el proyecto puede traer buenos resultados.
items.english: Despite being expensive, the project can bring good results.
